GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004.06 (26 Jan 48) OGA
(SCAPIN - 1852/1)
APO 500
11 September 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Submission of Monthly Labor Report.
1. Reference: AG 004.06 (26 Jan 48)OGA, SCAPIN 1852, 26 January 1948, subject: Submission of Monthly Labor Report.
2. Paragraphs 3c and d of reference directive are rescinded and the following substituted therefor:
"3. c. Total net earnings by laborers supplied to the Allied Forces by the Japanese Government on Labor Requisition from the first through the last day of the month.
d. Total net earnings by laborers supplied direct to the Allied Forces by the Japanese Government on Procurement Demand from the first through the last day of the month."
3. Direct communication Between the General Accounting Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Labor Section, Accommodation Division, Special Procurement Board, concerning matters within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
